scope: Independent bounded live-wrapper QA through a fresh CUA Chrome tab; no source, Site, Pixpa, GitHub, or OS-preference mutations.

narrow.limitation: Narrow mouse/fine-pointer viewport test, not physical-phone or touch certification. Child cross-origin coarse-pointer emulation was not attempted or asserted. Fine-pointer scene is visibly letterboxed within the full-height iframe.

returnAndBack.action: Clicked the visible wrapper Return to main site link, then used browser Back.
returnAndBack.returnTitle: Southern California Heirloom Portrait Studio | Kiyono Creative Lab
returnAndBack.toolNote: The Back command timed out after navigation. Reacquiring the same known tab verified the correct gallery URL, rendered gallery, focus on Return link, and exact pre-exit progress. No second Back action was issued.

measurement: Progress values are the cross-origin child accessibility tree's Aisle progress indicator, corroborated by normal screenshots; no injected scroll or app-state manipulation.
